title: new-hires
text:
new-hires

Orka Sundar: hey everyone! just joined today — thrilled to be here :wave: I’m Orka (they/them), previously did infra stuff and a bit of ops. excited for archery club and dim sum runs. desk is 3B-14 if anyone wants to say hi in person.
Harper Lin: welcome!! :tada: archery + dim sum is an excellent combo. i’ll snag you for lunch tomorrow if you’re free — we usually hit Golden Lotus around 12:30.
Juno Park: hi Orka!! we have a tiny origami table on the roof sometimes too. plants > me but happy to trade tips. welcome-bot said to remind you to fill the security form if you haven’t yet.
Orka Sundar: thanks Harper — count me in :bento: and Juno, origami table sounds legendary, i fold terrible cranes but will bring snacks.
Devon Ortiz: hey Orka, FYI onboarding slack thread: https://redwood.example/onboarding — there’s a checklist, and your keycard pickup is at Facilities desk 2.
Facilities: package arrived for Orka Sundar — we put it on bench A by the kitchen. ping if you need it delivered to desk 3B-14.
Mikaela Diaz: welcome!! also, if you want an extra bow for the archery meetup, i’ve got a spare (and a stash of target stickers) :bow_and_arrow:
Sammy: hi hi, pro tip: the 3rd-floor coffee machine likes you to press the big silver button twice. also there’s a tiny succulent on 3B-12 that i rescued last week if you’re into plant adoption.
Orka Sundar: lol noted about the coffee machine, will press responsibly. thanks for the warm welcome everyone — excited to meet y’all in person :heart:
welcome-bot: Don’t forget to join the #archery-club and #lunch-rotations channels. New hire welcome lunch scheduled: Thu 12:30. RSVP in the event thread: https://calendar.example/event/6452109876
Harper Lin: adding you to lunch RSVP. also, if you want a quick tour let me know — i’ll show you the best tea stash in the office.
Devon Ortiz: quick slack note — set up 2FA and the SSH keys, then ping infra for repo access. cheers and welcome again :rocket:
Mikaela Diaz: also — weekend rooftop meet tomorrow at 4 if you like sunset practice. small group, very low pressure.
Orka Sundar: thanks again! i’ll do the checklist tonight and try not to embarrass myself at archery. see you all soon :smile:
